target_questions: Which technology/software video purposes can be meaningfully distinguished?
Which observed platform metrics actually measure technical learning audiences versus adjacent aesthetics?
What would representative audience and earnings evidence require?

segments.label: Programming and coding tutorials
segments.provenance: Illustrative curated examples, not search-volume statistics

segments.label: Software use and troubleshooting
segments.provenance: Publisher broad learning/how-to views include many nonsoftware subjects

segments.label: Professional software and productivity workflows
segments.provenance: Crosses software teaching and lifestyle/workspace publishing; no joint sample

segments.label: Computing hardware and device reviews
segments.provenance: Desk setup publisher examples do not quantify all hardware review content

segments.label: Device repair and technical DIY
segments.provenance: Learning/how-to aggregate is broader than repair and not an identified repair sample

segments.label: Desk setup and workspace aesthetics
segments.provenance: Source reports title-matched views, not distinct people or technology product sales

observed_public_metrics.population: Matching title-query videos across all styles

observed_public_metrics.query: YouTube internal learning and how-to category (coding rules not published)
observed_public_metrics.population: All subjects YouTube describes as learning and how-to

required_research_design: Use independent published sampling frame for software, coding, repair, reviews and workspace content; measure overlap rather than assigning exclusive channels.
Prespecify platform view metric and stable dates, compare only similar units and account for August 24, 2026 counting change.
Record official creator/upload rates and channel age with ethically accessible public/authorized metadata, not hidden Analytics.
Do not confuse product review sponsorships, affiliate commissions, teaching revenue and ad money; calculate cost and time separately.
Include newcomer, zero-income and inactive channels before estimating creator earnings and business viability.
Study audience country and content language separately; do not extrapolate a US how-to view period to worldwide technology education.
